prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-colour gold-leaf body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 3 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 30% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 65% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries applied 24K YELLOW GOLD metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright 24K YELLOW GOLD sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied COPPER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright COPPER sheen filling every gap. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries applied AMETHYST VIOLET metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright AMETHYST VIOLET sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
